Electrochemical measurements 
The electrochemical testing was performed on a Princeton VMC-4 electrochemical 
workstation with a three-electrode system in 6 M KOH. A Hg/HgO electrode was used 
as a reference electrode, and a platinum foil was used as the c ounter electrode. The 
working electrode was prepared as follows. Firstly, CAC T-R (80wt%), acetylene black 
(10wt%), and polytetrafluoroethylene (10wt%) were mixed with et hanol to form well 
blended slurry. Then, the slurry was rolled into a sheet and punched into a disk-like film 
with 8 mm diameter. Finally, the electrode sheet was pressed onto the surface of the Ni-
foam disk with a pressure of 10 MPa and then dried at 70 °C for 24 h.
